title: pre-push hook refuses the rehearsal push v2-dev:release/X.Y
author: Claude-JG
description: The hook judged a push to GitHub by the local ref, so git push github v2-dev:release/1.14 - the rehearsal command of RELEASE.md - was refused as a push of v2-dev. It judges the remote ref, what lands on GitHub; the local ref only if the remote one is empty.
releaseNotes: The pre-push hook judges a push to GitHub by the ref it creates there, so git push github v2-dev:release/X.Y, the rehearsal of a release, is allowed, and a push of v2-dev itself is still refused.
